Sharjeel Imam's interim bail cancelled by Delhi court

A Delhi court has cancelled the interim bail granted to activist Sharjeel Imam. The Delhi Police had moved the court seeking cancellation, alleging that Imam had breached the conditions of his bail, specifically a media gag order. The case relates to the Delhi riots and involves charges under the UAPA.
